blocks.text: Spam woh unwanted (ghair zaroori, jo aap ne nahi maange) messages hain jo aap ko email ya phone par milte hain.

Misal: Aap ko anjaan numbers se bohat se SMS aa sakte hain jo aisi cheezein ya services pesh karte hain jo aap ne nahi maangi. Pakistan mein in messages mein jaali inaam (fake prizes) ya saste qarz (low-cost loans) ki offers ho sakti hain. Aise messages tang karte hain aur waqt zaya karte hain. Yeh aap ko dhoka de kar aap ki personal maloomat ya paise nikalwane ki koshish bhi kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Jis inaam mein aap ne hissa hi nahi liya, us ke SMS ka jawab kyun nahi dena chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh zyada tar spam ya dhoka hai jo aap ki personal maloomat ya paise chahta hai. Jawab dene se bhejne wale ko yeh bhi pata chal jata hai ke aap ka number chalu hai, to aur zyada spam aa sakta hai.

items: Spam: email ya phone par unwanted messages (jaali inaam, saste qarz); waqt zaya karte aur dhoke se maloomat ya paise le sakte hain.
